Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision
you reported in Baytown, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give you my first name for now. It's fine to continue.
Q: That works. Can you describe what you were doing right before the collision?
A: I had just pulled into a space near the store entrance. I was backing out slowly because the lot was crowded, and I
had checked my mirrors before moving.
Q: Where was the other vehicle when you first noticed it?
A: It came around the end of the row from my right. I didn't see it until it was pretty close. I tapped the brakes, but we
still made contact on the rear quarter panel of my car.
Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt, and did the airbags deploy?
A: Yes, I had my belt on. The airbags did not deploy. I felt a hard jolt forward and then back.
Q: Did you feel any pain or injury right after the impact?
A: Not right away. About an hour later my left knee started to swell and it got hard to bend. I went to urgent care that
evening and they took X-rays and told me to keep it wrapped and off stairs.
Q: Have you seen a doctor since then?
A: Yes, I have a follow-up scheduled with an orthopedic clinic. They mentioned it could be a ligament strain, but they
want an MRI before deciding anything.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I want the claim handled quickly, since I'm missing work and can't drive comfortably right now.
Q: Thank you. That concludes this statement.
</page>
